title: Tighten the test-ref authority bullet: parent reachable from origin/master, not a landing, deletion refspec, grant citation
outcome: Tighten the test-ref authority bullet: parent reachable from origin/master, not a landing, deletion refspec, grant citation
acceptance: The test-ref bullet in AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md requires the test commit's parent to be reachable from origin/master at push time, so a push cannot publish unpushed local commits through the ref
The bullet states that a test-ref push is not a landing, so the master pre-push checks and the full-gate landing condition do not apply to it, and names the refspec used to delete the ref
The bullet's grant citation names Greg's recorded route for attaching the push to the merger role (Advisor #1783/#1785/#1788) rather than only the word about Opus
The change lands under the authority-text rule: both coordinators' concurrence on the exact wording, Greg sent the wording, and the final-diff audit recorded as passed
